name: National Cancer Society of Malaysia
summary: Works to cut cancer deaths in Malaysia through public education, affordable screening, and care and support for patients and families.
programmes: Cancer and health screening clinic (breast, cervical, colorectal, prostate)
Nuclear medicine centre and quit-smoking clinic
Psychosocial support and peer support groups
Homes of Hope for children and adults travelling for treatment
beneficiaries: Cancer patients, survivors and families, and the general public needing screening and information

organisation.founders: The late Dato' Dr S.K. Dharmalingam, Malaysia's first oncologist; launched by then Prime Minister Tun Abdul Razak
organisation.leadership: Dato' Dr Saunthari Somasundaram (President); Dato' Seri Dr T Devaraj, Dr Felix Sundram, Dr Lam Chin Chyou (Vice Presidents); Pan Choi Yen (Hon. Gen. Secretary); Ravi Navaratnam (Hon. Gen. Treasurer); Patron: Sultan Nazrin Muizzuddin Shah of Perak
